SELECT
    s.sector_name_zh AS 行业名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 贷款笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 不良笔数,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 6) AS 不良笔数占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector s ON op.industry_code = s.sector_code
LEFT JOIN risk_classification rc
    ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
GROUP BY s.sector_code, s.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 不良笔数占比 DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 合同金额合计
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(product_id) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 合同金额合计
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.borrower_party_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(e.record_id) AS 记录数,
       ROUND(SUM(e.observed_value), 2) AS 观测值合计
FROM data_security_event_v3 e
JOIN institution i ON e.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE e.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 观测值合计 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(c.net_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot c
JOIN institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    d.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    d.principal_overdue_days AS 逾期天数,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 分类名称,
    r.as_of_date AS 分类日期
FROM (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_overdue_days
    FROM delinquency_snapshot d1
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM delinquency_snapshot d2 WHERE d2.loan_id = d1.loan_id)
) d
JOIN (
    SELECT loan_id, grade_code, as_of_date
    FROM risk_classification r1
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM risk_classification r2 WHERE r2.loan_id = r1.loan_id)
) r ON d.loan_id = r.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON r.grade

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ps.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY SUM(lbs.principal_balance) DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    ind.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS restricted_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector s ON op.industry_code = s.sector_code
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_id, ma.maturity_on, wp.actual_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

WITH guarantor_counts AS (
    SELECT guarantor_party_id AS party_id, COUNT(*) AS guarantee_count
    FROM guarantor_commitment
    GROUP BY guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_counts AS (
    SELECT borrower_party_id AS party_id, COUNT(*) AS borrower_agreement_count
    FROM credit_agreement
    GROUP BY borrower_party_id
)
SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, gc.guarantee_count, bc.borrower_agreement_count
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_counts gc ON p.party_id = gc.party_id
JOIN borrower_counts bc ON p.party_id = bc.party_id
ORDER BY gc.guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    p.business_date AS 业务日期,
    pt.name_zh AS 交易类型中文名称,
    p.amount AS 金额,
    ou.unit_name AS 经办机构单元名称
FROM payment_event p
JOIN payment_type_catalog pt ON p.payment_type = pt.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
  AND p.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY p.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ind_org.sector_name_zh AS 借款人注册行业名称,
    ind_target.sector_name_zh AS 协议投向行业名称,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind_org ON op.industry_code = ind_org.sector_code
JOIN industry_sector ind_target ON ca.target_industry_code = ind_target.sector_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    payer_holder.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    payee_holder.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder payer_holder 
    ON pe.from_account_id = payer_holder.account_id 
    AND payer_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder payee_holder 
    ON pe.to_account_id = payee_holder.account_id 
    AND payee_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON (payer_holder.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND payee_holder.party_id = pr.target_party_id)
    OR (payer_holder.party_id = pr.target_party_id AND payee_holder.party_id = pr.source_party_id)
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(*) AS 笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event p
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT s.staff_id AS 员工工号, COUNT(*) AS 笔数
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member s ON so.staff_id = s.staff_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON pe.to_account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY s.staff_id
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC, s.staff_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    r.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    r.event_date,
    r.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(r.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       ca.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
       ca.status AS 抵押物状态,
       sa.status AS 担保合同状态
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
       ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
       sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       r.loan_id AS 借据编号,
       r.principal_balance AS 本金余额,
       r.rn AS 余额排名
FROM (
    SELECT ld.loan_id,
           ca.institution_id,
           lbs.principal_balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY ca.institution_id
               ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
        AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
) r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
loan_industry AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        COALESCE(sec.sector_name_zh, '其他行业') AS sector_name_zh
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN latest_balance lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    LEFT JOIN industry_sector sec ON sec.sector_code = op.industry_code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        sector_name_zh,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sector_name_zh ORDER BY principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan_industry
)
SELECT
    sector_name_zh,
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    rn AS rank_in_sector
